# Jotform

> > Jotform is a no-code online form builder platform enabling users to create forms, collect payments, automate workflows, and integrate with business applications.

Jotform provides a drag-and-drop interface for building custom forms for registrations, surveys, payments, and data collection. The platform includes workflow automation, CRM capabilities, conditional logic, and integrations with popular business tools like Google and Apple services.
